stream_first_service.note: The six streaming GPU groups and all 21 host report tests passed. The expected-count assertion stopped the controller before its final resource snapshot; the first service peak was not captured.

wallet_test_coverage.proof_profile: Unchanged production quadratic wallet profile; hiding PCS, 96 queries, blowup 16, query PoW 16 bits.
features: Shared raw witness encoders, public AIR geometry and integer wallet kernel bodies serve both CUDA and OpenCL.
Native CUDA writes Poseidon traces, range/position/value accumulators, validates inputs and derives public values in three completed kernel launches.
Trace and public-value buffers remain resident and feed the existing native STARK path directly.
Independent CPU trace/public oracles cover plain, redeem/refund, noncanonical key words, field/range boundaries, minting and mixed Merkle paths.
Full raw-witness proofs use no CPU trace builder, pass unchanged production CPU verification and reject altered public statements.
Invalid witness, asset/path/conservation/range/mode/owner/timeout/mint failures release device scratch and outputs.
Host allowance, device byte/allocation limits and CPU-required policy rejection precede private upload and leave device counters unchanged.
Successful and failed generation release all intermediate device allocations. Raw host staging and device buffers are scrubbed on drop.
CUDA kernel target compilation passes compute_70 and compute_120.

generation_transfers.boundary: Per wallet generation, excluding public engine constants/preparation and the subsequent independent oracle/proof verification.

stage_receipts.timing: Actual CUDA completion-event durations, not host wall-clock envelopes.
stage_receipts.enforcement: CPU-required requests reject CUDA. GPU-required coverage needs completed device observations. Missing/lost/overflowed receipts and partial component coverage cannot satisfy a complete request.

admission.host: Exact-capacity raw-input staging with existing shared allowance; private staging is scrubbed on every exit path.
admission.device: Trace, public values, input words, geometry and status are admitted together against current managed bytes, allocation size and allocation count.
admission.kernel_local_memory: All six kernels pass the existing per-thread and context-backing admission after loading.

limitations: Explicit native wallet generation and proof composition; public request/backend selection and persistent worker/pool integration are not yet connected.
Only witness/public generation has CUDA stage receipts in this checkpoint. Remaining native STARK stages need receipts before full-request GPU-required coverage can be claimed.
Batch wallet traces, recursive batch/lookup proving, preprocessing and whole-request resource admission remain unfinished.
Correctness and resource qualification only; no end-to-end transaction-throughput or CPU/GPU performance result is claimed.
Execution is qualified only on the desktop RTX 5080. Volta has target compilation coverage; V100 execution, Metal execution and multiple GPUs remain untested.
Deterministic proof seeds and fixtures are test-only. The existing production proof parameters and verifier are unchanged.
The intentional missing-kernel test runs outside sanitizers. All five primitive benchmarks are excluded from qualification.
qualification_note: The first focused build caught a test helper using the wrong runtime constructor name; correction preceded all passing focused and frozen-source checks. The stream reporting suite passed 21 tests; the controller initially expected 20. Only that host reporting check was rerun with the corrected expected count; all six successful streaming GPU groups and the unchanged source/binary pins were retained. The shared OpenCL build runs before sanitizer checks. GPU tests run serially under 3 GiB RAM, zero swap, four CPU cores and 96 tasks. The stream build uses 6 GiB RAM and one build job.
